## Purpose

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Experimental impact

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Implementation change without a claim about published results
- [ ] Changes measurement or validation behavior
- [ ] Introduces a separate experiment or dataset

Explain any effect on the frozen protocol, canonical data, paper, figures, or release artifacts.

## Verification

- [ ] Python unit tests pass
- [ ] JCS 4 core builds from the pinned submodule
- [ ] Benchmark harness tests pass
- [ ] Generated output, secrets, and local environment files are excluded
- [ ] Documentation and provenance are updated where required

## Evidence

List commands executed and provide concise results. Link larger artifacts rather than committing generated benchmark output.
